title: Azulo: Monastery
author: badtradingdecisions
selftext:
I've build this game lately. It's my 3rd game this year, but second from Azulo universe. I focus on puzzle games inspired by Azulejo tiles. I've got an idea while travelling through Portugal and Spain and AI finally helped me to make it.

I am pretty sure I could have done it before AI as well but it would take 10x the time it took now. Thr absolute game changer AI is for me, are assets. That was probably the biggest blocker for me in the past. But gpt is doing pretty solid job now.

I've built 2 asset generators for this. They use the same default logic but have different settings and allow different tweaks. I think this is the future. Small dedicated tools spinned of when needed instead of some robust software doing everything.

It's still took me 3+ months to build. Mostly because I have a 997 job + family and it took a lot of time to make sure murals look good, are playable, progress is entertaining and it still fits on mobile.

Spent:

Chatgpt 20$/mo - I am constantly hitting "too many images generated" but got better at prompting my ideas so I am more efficient.

Claude 20$/mo plan - was mostly ok, hit a quota a few times but because I can't work on this 24/7 it is mostly fine. It got definitely worse over the last 3 months. Both personal projects and in work tokens are flying faster and faster for the same tasks IMO.

Fal.ai - spent 10$ for some animated assets

Suno - 2 months of sub 8$/mo

Apple/Google fees

I am planning to keep going. Tokens are still cheap but not for much too long.

comments.author: Pizzaman2948
comments.body: What model did you use for the images?

replies.author: badtradingdecisions
replies.body:
Gtp-image-2. Most of it is just GPT chat and tweaking until I am happy, giving it examples.

Murals and main menu assets are through API, I've built my own generator where I tweak settings and then just keep changing the prompt describing the motif and keep regenerating until I am happy. It took some iterations, but now I can generate what I want with 2-3 repeats.

I've burned maybe 100$ on API, forgot to add that
